reviews.notes: Severely polluted. Two distinct problems: (1) a 26-row block of generic ISCO group-label junk (all aka=NaN) that must be removed wholesale; (2) a large real-role environmental/ecology/aquaculture/botany cluster (ISCO 2133/3142) that is NOT biomedical and appears to belong to an environmental-/life-sciences domain — flagged as overfanout rather than per-row remove to avoid over-listing. True biomedical core (pharmacologist, biochemist, microbiologist, immunologist, geneticist, physiologist, toxicologist, biophysicist, epidemiologist, bioinformatics scientist, medical lab assistant/technicians) is sound but is a minority of the current membership. Recommend a hard resplit of Biomedical vs Environmental/Life Sciences.
